Details & Features
A correctly designed storage tank is a central component of the system: it minimises pressure fluctuations during intermittent air extraction and reduces the frequency of compressor start-ups thanks to sufficient storage capacity. This storage system is specially designed for the storage and transport of helium in mobile applications. It consists of 12 vertically arranged cylinders and is certified in accordance with 2010/35/EU-TPED.

Details & Features
A correctly designed storage tank is a central component of the system: it minimises pressure fluctuations during intermittent air extraction and reduces the frequency of compressor start-ups thanks to sufficient storage capacity. This storage system is specially designed for the storage and transport of helium in mobile applications. It consists of 12 vertically arranged cylinders and is certified in accordance with 2010/35/EU-TPED.
